messages:
Maya: Heads-up  partner wants a certified LangChain + LlamaIndex gateway integration bundled with their NVIDIA marketplace SKU. Need owners and a lean plan.
Ibrahim: Eng can deliver a v0 adapter (ingest, query, embeddings, basic batching) in ~9 working days. will include smoke tests.
Faye: DevRel can make a 6-step tutorial + 90s demo clip once adapter supports streaming responses. prefer a small KB example (privacy-safe).
Maya: Marketplace/legal: publisher agreement + security attestation required. also need feature matrix (flows supported), 512x512 icon, and support contact.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: manifest and asset pack due 10 business days before publish window. include pricing SKUs and vendor ID.
Ibrahim: sample demo curl for README:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/gateway-lc \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n  -d '{"flow":"kb->rerank->summarize","source":"lindex://kb-sample","stream":true}'
```
Ibrahim: pushing adapter config today: name: rwd-gw-lc, batch:8, stream:true, quant:q4_0.
Faye: timeline suggestion: PR in 7 working days, QA+smoke 3 days, perf 3 days, assets+manifest 4 days, legal 5 days. external announce  4 weeks.
Maya: Perf ask: infra run a throughput sweep on A10x2 and return p95 and tokens/sec. Ibrahim, can infra run that?
InfraBot: Scheduled perf sweep (JOB-9001) on A10x2. expect results in 3 business days. provide short/long query mixes.
Maya: Owners: Adapter = @Ibrahim, Notebook+demo = @Faye, Perf = @InfraBot, Marketplace/legal = @Maya.
Faye: I'll draft announcement copy and ping design for GIFs once notebook link posted.
Ibrahim: PR draft today, tagging QA and infra.
Maya: OK team. internal target = adapter + smoke + perf in 3w, external listing in 4w. will run 10-min sync every Tue. react :white_check_mark: when done.
Ibrahim: :white_check_mark: PR queued.
Faye: :eyes: notebook scaffolded.
InfraBot: :soon: JOB-9001 running.
